title: proofgate judges the command xargs runs
intention: proofgate judges the command xargs runs, so a proof fed to python3 through xargs runs under the tester's seal and pytest through xargs is refused.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 in dda0e72b9c67's clause 4 census on akienasus: `ls <proof> | xargs -I{} python3 {}` was judged pass by proofgate.judge and the fixture proof wrote 1 path into the scratch HOME's .cairn. xargs is not in PREFIXES, so the segment's command word is xargs and nothing is judged.
traces_to: Law 4 (the seal is physics, not policy) and Law 8; dda0e72b9c67 decision D2.
how: Add xargs to PREFIXES so _command_word skips to the word xargs runs. In _verdict, when xargs stands before the command word and the word is python, the segment runs a proof if the script slot is empty or equals xargs's -I/-i/--replace value AND a token of an earlier segment names a proofs/ path (PROOF_PATH, PROOF_GLOB, or (^|/)proofs(/|$)). A real script slot is judged by _runs_a_proof as before. Three teeth in bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py under this ticket's PROVES key, appended to _main.

clauses.claim: `ls <proof> | xargs python3` and `ls <proof> | xargs -I{} python3 {}` are judged rewrite, the command wrapped in `cairn test --exec`
`ls <proofs dir> | xargs pytest` and `ls <proof> | xargs -n1 python3 -m pytest` are refused
`ls tools/*.py | xargs python3 tools/x.py`, `echo a | xargs echo` and `ls <proof> | xargs wc -l` are judged None

decisions.text: D1: xargs joins PREFIXES; _verdict judges a python that xargs runs with an empty or replace-string script slot by whether an earlier segment names a proofs/ path.
D2: three teeth, one per clause, under this ticket's PROVES key in the gate's proof, appended to _main.
